info.description:
Single-venue console gaming cafe POS.
Money is integer BDT; times are ISO-8601 with offset (+06:00).
Every non-2xx response uses the ErrorResponse envelope.
info.title: Gamer's Den API

get.description: Newest first: cash discrepancies at a shift close, print jobs that gave up, and items that crossed their reorder point. unread=true is what the bell badge counts.

post.description: Marks every unread alert read and answers with what is left — the same list GET /alerts gives.
post.summary: Clear the bell

post.description: Idempotent by nature — an alert already read stays read, and says so.
post.summary: Mark one alert read

post.description: Returns a 15-minute access token and sets the 12-hour rotating refresh cookie. 401 on a wrong PIN, 423 LOCKED_PIN after 5 consecutive failures.
post.summary: Sign in with staff id + 4-digit PIN
Revoke the refresh token and clear the cookie

post.description: The presented cookie is spent; replaying it revokes the whole session family and answers 401.
post.summary: Rotate the refresh cookie for a fresh access token

get.summary: The pre-booking flag, package fee and cancellation window

put.description: Every field optional; omitted fields keep their stored value. New bookings only — existing bookings keep the fee and cutoff they were sold under. Switching enabled off refuses new bookings with 409 PREBOOKING_DISABLED; the ones already paid for still check in and cancel.

get.description: upcoming = PAID, soonest first; history = ARRIVED, USED and CANCELLED, most recent slot first. Rows on the Upcoming tab carry overlapping=true when another live booking shares their console and their time.

post.description: One database transaction: the transaction snapshot with its booking_amount, the tender, the booking row and the print job carrying the P1 receipt and the P7 confirmation. The play total is blocks x the console's rate at the booked time and the package fee comes from /booking-settings; both are snapshotted onto the booking, so later edits to either reach new bookings only. 409 PREBOOKING_DISABLED when the feature is off, SPLIT_MISMATCH when the tender does not equal what is due, PAYMENT_REF_REQUIRED on a bKash/Nagad payment with no TrxID; each leaves nothing written. An overlap with another booking on the same console is returned as a warning, not refused.

parameters.description: UUID. The first call is stored for 48 h; an identical retry replays it with Idempotency-Replayed: true and the same bookingId / transactionId / printJobId.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.summary: Take payment and hold a slot

post.description: Only while PAID and while now <= startAt - the booking's own cutoffHours snapshot; the boundary itself still cancels. Writes a full negative transaction against the sale, posted to the shift doing the cancelling. 409 CANCEL_CUTOFF_PASSED inside the window, ALREADY_CHECKED_IN once the customer has arrived — that money goes back through a Manager+ void of the transaction instead.

parameters.description: UUID. An identical retry replays the stored response, so the refund is written once.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.summary: Cancel a booking and refund it in full

post.description: Assigns the next daily queue token off the row-locked token_seq, writes its queue entry, moves the booking to ARRIVED and queues the P6 stub — one transaction. The token is shared with walk-up play tickets and restarts at venue midnight. Works while pre-booking is switched off: a booking already paid for stays serviceable. 409 ALREADY_CHECKED_IN on a second tap.
post.summary: Check in and print the token

post.description: 201 with a new cart. A session has exactly one cart (carts.session_id is UNIQUE), so asking again for a seat that already has one returns it with 200 instead of failing.
post.summary: Open a cart

put.description: qty 0 removes the line. A new line snapshots the item's price; changing the quantity keeps that snapshot. 409 OUT_OF_STOCK when the request exceeds the shelf minus what other open carts already hold.

get.description: Server-sent events: station-update (sessions and match timers), queue-update, booking-update, tournament-update, alert, printer-status and sync-status. Each payload is the shape of the GET it mirrors, so a handler can write it straight into the cache the polling fallback fills. Events are emitted after the transaction that caused them commits, so nothing arrives for work that rolled back. The stream is closed periodically by the server — reconnect, and poll every 10 s meanwhile.
Newest first. Defaults to the open shift on this terminal; pass shiftId to read a closed one back.

post.description: Posted to the open shift on this terminal, where it subtracts from the expected drawer. 409 when no shift is open — money cannot leave a till nobody has opened. voucher=true also queues the P4 slip.
post.summary: Record a petty-cash payment

get.description: Grouped by category, alphabetical inside it. The POS passes active=true; S10's editor passes nothing and sees retired rows too.

post.description: 409 DUPLICATE_NAME when the name is taken. An opening stock lands as an INITIAL stock_movements row.
post.summary: Add a menu item (Manager+)

delete.description: Deleted outright while nothing points at it; once it has sales or stock history the row is deactivated instead, so the audit survives.
delete.summary: Take an item off the menu (Manager+)

get.summary: One menu row with its derived stock state

patch.description: stock is the absolute counted figure; the difference is audited as one signed MANUAL_ADJUST movement. 409 DUPLICATE_NAME on a taken name.
patch.summary: Edit a menu item or correct its stock (Manager+)

put.description: null resets to the default swatch.

get.description: One box over name and phone: the name matches anywhere, the phone on digits so typed separators do not matter. No q lists everyone, by name.

post.description: 409 DUPLICATE_PHONE when the number is already on file — the phone is compared normalised. An opening top-up is a separate wallet call.
post.summary: Register a member

get.description: Visits are the last sessions the member was attached to, newest first. The bookings list joins here in B15.
get.summary: One member with their recent visits

post.description: Requires an Idempotency-Key. 1 point = ৳1; both ledgers and both columns move in one transaction. 409 INSUFFICIENT_POINTS.
post.summary: Convert points to wallet balance

post.description: Requires an Idempotency-Key. Writes the TOPUP ledger row and the members.wallet total in one transaction.
post.summary: Add money to a wallet

get.description: Occupancy is this instant; the KPI tiles are the venue day; the trends are the last 30 venue days against the 30 before them. Pre-sold is money taken for play not yet delivered — PAID bookings plus WAITING play tickets. Nothing is stored; everything is folded per request.
get.summary: Today's KPIs, the pre-sold stat, trends, stock watchlist and closes

post.description: One database transaction: the transaction snapshot and its tenders, the blocks it pays for, the stock it sells, the loyalty it moves, and the receipt print job. The session keeps running — paid blocks simply stop being billable. 409 SPLIT_MISMATCH when the tenders do not equal what is due, WALLET_INSUFFICIENT past the member's balance, PAYMENT_REF_REQUIRED on a bKash/Nagad row with no TrxID, TOURNAMENT_FULL / TOURNAMENT_NOT_OPEN on an entry that cannot be registered; each of them leaves nothing written. tournamentEntries[] come back as entryTokens[], one QR per entry, printed as P5 stubs on the same receipt. playTickets[] come back as queueTokens[], one daily token per ticket, printed as P6 stubs on the same receipt and entered in the play queue as WAITING — they are sellable while every console is busy, which is the whole point of the queue.

parameters.description: UUID. The first call is stored for 48 h; an identical retry replays it with Idempotency-Replayed: true and the same transactionId / printJobId.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.summary: Settle a session bill or a counter cart

post.description: Manager+, and only within the shift that took the money. Writes a negative reversal transaction with negated tenders, releases the blocks it paid for back to billable, puts the stock back with VOID movements, revokes any play-queue token it sold that is still waiting, and hands the loyalty back — one transaction, like the settle it undoes. The original row is never edited, only flagged with its reason.
post.summary: Reverse a settled payment in full

get.description: Every WAITING token in counter order, then today's SEATED ones as history. Waiting tokens are not filtered to today: one issued yesterday and never seated keeps working and keeps its place, carrying its own tokenDate — the entry id is the key, not the number, which restarts at venue midnight.

delete.description: Manager+. One database transaction: a negative transaction against the sale, for the amount the token was sold at, and the token flipped to REFUNDED. The row is kept — the refund hangs off it — and the rail simply stops listing it. Walk-up tickets only: a checked-in booking's token is refunded by voiding its transaction, which revokes the token with it. 409 CONFLICT on a token already seated or already refunded.

post.description: One database transaction: the session, its prepaid session_blocks born carrying the original sale's paid_tx_id, the token to SEATED, and — when the token came from a pre-booking — the booking to USED. The clock starts when staff press start, and extra time is ordinary billable +30 blocks. Any waiting token may be seated, not just the first: the customer chooses. 409 CONSOLE_TYPE_MISMATCH on the wrong console type, STATION_BUSY on a taken seat, STATION_RESERVED while a tournament holds it.
post.summary: Seat a waiting token on a console

post.description: The standalone alias for POST /payments playTickets[]. One database transaction: the transaction snapshot with its booking_amount, the tender, the queue entry holding the next daily token, and the print job carrying the P1 receipt and the P6 stub. Sellable while every console is busy — that is what the queue is for. 409 PAYMENT_REF_REQUIRED on a bKash/Nagad sale with no TrxID; 400 on a console type the rate card does not know.

parameters.description: UUID. The first call is stored for 48 h; an identical retry replays it with Idempotency-Replayed: true and the same token / transactionId / printJobId — no second number comes off the daily counter.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.summary: Sell one prepaid play-queue token

get.summary: The rate card, one entry per console type

put.description: Each entry names its consoleType. New blocks only — running sessions keep the prices they purchased.
put.summary: Set rates for one or more console types (Admin)

get.description: QUEUED, PRINTING, DONE or FAILED, with the attempt count, the device, the operator, and — on a reprint — its reason and the original job. A FAILED job carries which failure it was (PAPER_OUT, COVER_OPEN, OFFLINE, MID_PRINT), so S11 names the thing to fix.
The preview S11 draws, read back from the job — never recomputed. It was produced by the same pass that produced the bytes on the paper, so what is on screen is what came out of the printer.

post.description: A new job carrying the original's stored bytes under the reprint band, with the reason recorded and the original linked. The reason is required — 400 VALIDATION_FAILED without it. Reprinting another operator's ticket needs Manager+ (api-contract.md §1, "Void/reprint others' transactions").
post.summary: Print it again, on the record

post.description: The stored bytes go back to the printer unchanged — not a fresh render — so the reprinted ticket is byte-identical to the one that failed, including after a mid-print failure where half of it is already on paper. The attempt count keeps climbing rather than resetting. 409 CONFLICT on a job that is not FAILED: a QUEUED job is already going to print, and a DONE one needs a reprint reason.
post.summary: Re-queue a failed ticket, same bytes

get.description: Default first. Each row's status is polled from the device while answering — ONLINE, OFFLINE, OUT_OF_PAPER or COVER_OPEN — rather than read from a cache, because the answer is only useful if it is current.
get.summary: Attached printers and their live status

put.description: Admin, as terminal configuration is (api-contract.md §1). The id must be one GET /printers listed — 404 otherwise. The choice holds for this running process; the venue's standing default lives in configuration (gamersden.printing.default-device), because the printer model is still an OPEN FLAG and no schema document gives printers a table.
put.summary: Choose the printer the venue prints on

post.description: An ordinary print job — it queues, gets claimed, is attempted up to three times and ends DONE or FAILED like any receipt, so what it proves is the whole path and not just the cable. 404 on an id nothing answers to.
post.summary: Queue a test ticket on this printer

get.description: Every figure is folded from grouped reads at request time — nothing is stored, so a void or refund shows up immediately. Days are venue days (Asia/Dhaka), both bounds inclusive; the default range is the last 14 days. 400 when to is before from or the range is longer than a year.
get.summary: KPIs, trends, utilisation, busiest hours, top sellers and bookings

get.description: active=true (the default) lists live seats; active=false lists closed sessions, most recently ended first.

post.description: Opens a session with no time on it. With bookingId or queueEntryId the token's prepaid blocks are loaded as already paid and the token is consumed in the same transaction. 409 STATION_BUSY, STATION_RESERVED, CONSOLE_TYPE_MISMATCH.
post.summary: Seat a customer

get.summary: One session with its server-derived clock and balance

get.description: Gaming counts unbilled blocks only at their snapshot rates — prepaid blocks and blocks settled mid-session are already paid for and show as prepaidCredit instead of a charge. F&B comes from the unsettled cart, tournament entry fees from the session's registrations, and pointsRedeemable is min(member points, netTotal). Nothing here is stored.
get.summary: What this session owes right now

post.description: Requires an Idempotency-Key. +1 snapshots the current rate (morning window included) onto the new block; -1 returns the newest block that is neither paid for nor played, else 409 BLOCKS_CONSUMED.
post.summary: Buy or return one 30-minute block

post.description: START from OPEN, PAUSE from RUNNING, RESUME from PAUSED — anything else is 409 CONFLICT. Starting or resuming with no time left is 409 NO_BLOCKS.
post.summary: Start, pause or resume the clock

post.description: 409 SESSION_HAS_BALANCE while net outstanding — unpaid blocks plus the unsettled cart — is above zero. Prepaid blocks count as settled.
post.summary: End the session

get.description: Newest first, open shift included. The drawer figures are the Z snapshots and are absent on a shift that is still open.

post.description: 409 SHIFT_ALREADY_OPEN when one is already open here — the terminal, not the operator, is what a shift is unique per. The float is what is in the drawer before the first sale; the close counts against it.
post.summary: Open a shift on this terminal

post.description: One transaction: the Z figures snapshotted onto the shift, the P2 print job, an alert row when the count does not match, and the operator signed out of this terminal. A cashier may only close their own shift; Manager+ may close anyone's.
post.summary: Count the drawer and close the shift

get.description: Takings by method x category — gaming, F&B, tournament entries and pre-bookings — the shift's petty cash, and the cash the drawer should hold right now. Nothing is stored: ask again after the next sale and the figures will have moved. print=true also queues the P3 job.
get.summary: The interim read of this terminal's open shift

post.description: 409 DUPLICATE_NAME when the name is taken.
post.summary: Add a Manager or Cashier with a PIN (Admin)

delete.description: Deactivates rather than deletes — shifts, sessions and transactions keep pointing at the row. 409 STAFF_ON_SHIFT while a shift is open.

patch.description: 409 DUPLICATE_NAME on a taken name; a new PIN clears any lock and revokes that account's live refresh tokens.

get.description: Each station with its live session summary. A console held by a running tournament reads RESERVED, and carries its match countdown while one is being played on it. The checked-in arrival half arrives with B16 and is null until then.

post.description: 409 DUPLICATE_NAME when the name is taken.
post.summary: Add a station (Admin)

delete.description: 409 STATION_IN_USE while a session is live on it or any session history still points at it — put it under maintenance instead.

patch.description: 409 DUPLICATE_NAME on a taken name; 409 STATION_IN_USE when the console type or the maintenance flag would move under a live session.

get.description: SYNCED when nothing is pending, SYNCING when the venue is ahead of the cloud, OFFLINE when the last push attempt failed. The venue trades either way — the outbox drains on reconnect.
A terminal that has never been configured answers with the defaults: dark theme, default text size, Den Red, no background, sound on, 5-minute auto-lock, 1 receipt copy.

put.description: The whole object; every field is required except loginBgImageId, which carries the id of the terminal's uploaded background or null to remove it.

post.description: PNG, JPEG or WebP, validated by its own bytes rather than by the part's Content-Type. Replaces whatever the terminal had; the new id is what GET /terminal-settings/login-bg/{imageId} is fetched by.
post.summary: Upload this terminal's login background (Admin)

get.description: Public: the login screen renders it before sign-in. 404 once the background is removed or replaced.

post.description: The QR off the P5 stub, which has to match the entry it is presented against. 409 ALREADY_CHECKED_IN on a second scan.
post.summary: Mark a player as arrived

get.description: Soonest first. slotsLeft is what the POS Tournament category disables its card on.
get.summary: Events still selling or being played

post.description: maxPlayers must be one of 4, 8, 16 or 32 — a perfect bracket has exactly N-1 matches and no byes. 409 DUPLICATE_NAME on a taken name.
post.summary: Create an event (Manager+)

get.description: The History tab: winners, prizes and entry counts by date. A finished event carries winnerEntryId and winnerName; a called-off one carries its cancelledReason instead.
get.summary: Finished and called-off events, most recent first

get.description: bracket is empty until the event is drawn — before that the screen is the registered-player list. Every started match carries its own remainingSeconds, computed from the server clock.
get.summary: One event with its entries, blocked consoles and bracket

patch.description: Only while OPEN — 409 TOURNAMENT_NOT_OPEN otherwise. Once a ticket has been sold the entry fee is frozen and the cap cannot drop below the entries taken; both are 409 CONFLICT.

put.description: Replaces the whole allocation. While the event is OPEN or LIVE these consoles read RESERVED on the Floor and refuse walk-in sessions with 409 STATION_RESERVED; an empty list releases them.

post.description: For an event that never filled: the smallest power-of-two bracket that seats everybody who bought in, byes advancing the earliest seeds, and the event goes LIVE. An event that fills is drawn automatically by the sale that takes the last slot, so this is the undersubscribed case. 409 NOT_ENOUGH_PLAYERS under two players, 409 TOURNAMENT_NOT_OPEN once it is already live, done or called off.
post.summary: Draw the bracket now (Manager+)

post.description: One transaction: status CANCELLED, every console released, and a negative refund transaction per originating sale, posted to the shift open on this terminal. Money goes back through the methods it came in by.
post.summary: Call an event off and refund everyone (Manager+)

post.description: The same settle POST /payments runs: one transaction writes the money, the entry with its seed and QR, and the receipt with its P5 stub. 409 TOURNAMENT_FULL past the cap, TOURNAMENT_NOT_OPEN once the bracket is live.

parameters.description: UUID. An identical retry replays the stored response with Idempotency-Replayed: true — the same entry, the same QR, one charge.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.summary: Sell one entry at the counter

get.description: 403 for a cashier token, and never embedded in a shared payload. revenue = entries x entryFee; netProfit = revenue - prizePool; opportunityCost = (N-1) x matchDurationMin/60 x avgHourlyRate of the allocated consoles; extraMargin = netProfit - opportunityCost.
get.summary: Revenue against what the consoles would have earned (Manager+)

get.description: pending=true narrows it to the cashier job board: matches with both players and no winner yet. The consoles come with it, each carrying why it is or is not free — "Allocated console busy with a walk-in session" is the case start would otherwise refuse without explanation.
get.summary: The match board, with console availability

post.description: Minutes accumulate on the match; every countdown re-bases off the same read, so the board, the bracket tag, the "Now on" tile and the Floor card all move together. A match whose time is already up is the normal case. 409 CONFLICT on a match that has not been started or is already decided.
post.summary: Add time to a match in play

post.description: Takes the first allocated console that is neither hosting an unfinished match nor busy with a walk-in session, and stamps started_at — the countdown runs from there. 409 NO_FREE_CONSOLE when every allocated console is taken; the details list what each of them is doing.
post.summary: Put a match on a console

post.description: Any role for a match that has been started — that is execution. A match nobody started is a ruling and needs Manager+: a cashier gets the 403 envelope. The winner advances along next_match_id, and the response says which console their next match would take. Winning the final makes the champion, turns the event DONE and releases every console it held.
post.summary: Record the winner of a match

Alert.description: One row of the operator feed

Bill.description: What a session owes right now — unbilled blocks, F&B, tournament entries, and the prepaid credit already covering it

delta.description: +1 buys a 30-minute block at the current rate, -1 returns the newest unpaid, unplayed one

BookingCancelled.description: A cancelled booking and its refund

BookingCheckedIn.description: A booking checked in, holding a queue token

BookingCreated.description: A booking, paid for and held

BookingSettings.description: Pre-booking feature flag, package fee and cancellation window. Changes apply to NEW bookings only.

CloseShiftRequest.description: Count the drawer and close the shift

matchId.description: The match occupying it, if any

CreateBookingRequest.description: Take payment and hold a slot

CreateExpenseRequest.description: Record a petty-cash payment against the open shift

games.description: Free-text favourites shown on the member card

preferredConsole.description: PS5 or PS4 — what the desk seats them on by default

bookingId.description: Seat a checked-in booking — loads its prepaid blocks as paid

memberId.description: Attach a member to the seat for points and wallet at settle

queueEntryId.description: Seat a play-queue token — loads its prepaid blocks as paid

DefaultPrinterRequest.description: Which attached printer to print on

EntrySold.description: A tournament entry sold at the counter

Expense.description: A petty-cash payment posted to the shift that made it

minutes.description: Minutes to add on top of whatever has already been added

staffId.description: staff.id chosen on the login screen

consoles.description: Every console blocked for this event, in the order match start picks from

matches.description: Drawing order; with pending=true, only matches with both players and no winner yet

Member.description: A registered customer with their wallet and points balance

MemberBooking.description: A booking the member holds or has held

MemberDetail.description: A member with their recent visits and bookings

MemberVisit.description: A past or current session the member was attached to

OpenShiftRequest.description: Open the caller's terminal for business

Overview.description: S2's KPIs, pre-sold stat, trends, watchlist and closes

PlayTicketSold.description: A prepaid play-queue token, paid for

currentBlockPrice.description: The block price right now — morning discount already applied

PrintJob.description: One queued, printed or failed ticket

PrintRender.description: The stored character-grid render of a print job

Printer.description: An attached printer and its live status

QueueEntryRemoved.description: A no-show refunded and taken out of the queue

QueueEntrySeated.description: A token seated on a console

winnerEntryId.description: One of the two entries playing the match

points.description: Points to convert; the wallet gains the same number of BDT

Report.description: S9's aggregates over a range of venue days

ReportKpis.description: Takings, petty cash and net profit over a period

ReportTrendPoint.description: One venue day of takings, expenses and profit

ReprintRequest.description: Why this ticket is being printed again

SeatQueueEntryRequest.description: Which console to seat this token on

SellEntryRequest.description: Sell one tournament entry at the counter

Session.description: A floor session with its server-derived clock and balance

SettleRequest.description: Settle a session's bill or a counter cart

SettleResult.description: The transaction and the receipt a settle produced

Shift.description: A till session: who opened it, on which terminal, and how the drawer counted at the end

ShiftReport.description: A shift's takings by method and category, its petty cash, and what that says should be in the drawer

StationArrival.description: A checked-in booking waiting for this console

blocks.description: Prepaid 30-minute blocks that load when the token is seated

timeUp.description: Past zero — the card reads "match over" until a winner is recorded

paidBlocks.description: Blocks already paid — prepaid or settled

SyncStatus.description: Where the venue's outbox stands against the cloud

amount.description: Integer BDT added to the wallet

method.description: How the money came in — a wallet cannot fund itself, so no WALLET

paymentRef.description: bKash/Nagad TrxID, entered by hand in the MVP

winnerName.description: The champion; null until the final is decided

bracket.description: First round first; empty before the draw

avgHourlyRate.description: Mean rate-card hourly price of the allocated consoles' types

entries.description: Tickets still paid for; a refunded entry is not revenue

matches.description: N-1 for the configured cap — the consoles were held for the whole event, whatever the turnout

bye.description: One player, one empty bracket position — decided by the draw, never played

nextMatchId.description: The match this winner advances into; null on the final

remainingSeconds.description: (matchDurationMin + extraMinutes) x 60 - elapsed, floored at 0; null unless the match is on

timeUp.description: The countdown has hit zero — the match is over and the winner still has to be recorded

loginBgImageId.description: the id this terminal's last upload returned, or null to remove

VoidResult.description: The reversal transaction a void produced
